summary: Configured node1 so new interactive login sessions use umask 027. Verified persistence through a full node restart.
actions_performed: Changed the authoritative UMASK setting in /etc/login.defs from 022 to 027 while preserving ownership and permissions.
Verified a fresh interactive login creates files with mode 640 and directories with mode 750.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed system health and umask behavior after boot.

evidence.requirement: New interactive login sessions default to umask 027
evidence.summary: Configuration reports UMASK 027. Fresh interactive login shells reported 0027 and created mode-640 files and mode-750 directories both before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 6001d24d-a752-4a58-a0b2-082876564497; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 1558b44c-388e-40e3-b29b-cbef3a11e212. The system recovered to running with zero failed units, active systemd-logind, readable login data, and persistent umask 027 behavior.
